construct: Loss-of-function variants in IGSF1 cause an X-linked syndrome whose characteristic endocrine phenotype includes central hypothyroidism and macroorchidism; hypoprolactinemia, delayed pubertal testosterone rise, obesity, and attention problems can also occur.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Central hypothyroidism with low prolactin, macroorchidism, disharmonious puberty, and an affected maternal-line male is the characteristic X-linked IGSF1 deficiency phenotype.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: TSHB and TRHR defects can cause central hypothyroidism but not the characteristic X-linked macroorchidism phenotype; TBL1X has a different syndromic pattern, and POU1F1 typically causes broader combined pituitary hormone deficiency.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Macroorchidism plus X-linked family structure and central hypothyroidism provide the discriminating combination; no listed alternative matches all three.
